title: Class Unit Zeta Perf
objective: Profile and materially reduce motivating-quintic certified zeta workspace cost without changing proof intervals

handoff.summary: Replaced pathological tuple-key BF-plan aggregation with nested exact-integer maps and bounded finite-sum provenance while retaining the identical sorted plan and exact outward-dyadic interval. On bench-1 the motivating quintic improved from 154.87s to 80.67s wall (engine 76.08s, peak RSS 525152KB); the exact finite endpoints and splitting-record hash match the reference. The degree-7 phase probe completed in 145.93s and showed relation search, not splitting, as the remaining dominant stage.
risks: The exact finite fold remains the dominant zeta component at roughly 16-18 seconds; a future mature FLINT/Arb batched implementation would still require the current dynamic fallback and exact differential oracle.
Increasing the splitting block size from 4096 to 65536 saved only about 0.1 seconds and is deliberately not part of this change.
The repository-wide test:changed run was stopped after the relevant class/unit integration batch passed; later unrelated integration batches were not completed in this lane.
next_steps: Cherry-pick e187bd231383fbd74c6e1764b0228cd65466094f and then 72cc74b675a996888d22cc8ae8db740987d6b77f; the intervening benchmark-instrumentation commit is optional.
Profile relation collection for degree 7, where it accounts for 90.91 seconds of the 144.35-second engine runtime.
